title: SCL-Shadow: Self-Calibrated Shadow Detection with Spatial Consistency Constraints under Noisy Labels
description: Official code for the paper "Self-Calibrated Shadow Detection with Spatial Consistency Constraints under Noisy Labels" (submitted to The Visual Computer). A training-time, backbone-agnostic framework that makes shadow detectors robust to label noise via Iterative Confidence Aggregation (ICA), Spatial Consistency Verification (SCV), and a Boundary Refined Loss Function (BRLF), without changing the raw labels and with zero extra inference cost.
